content.study:
Section 43I — General norms for grading of arbitral institutions

Section 43I provides the statutory basis for general norms concerning grading of arbitral institutions, subject to the Act and the applicable regulatory framework.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework. Its operative use depends on the current text, commencement status and regulations made under the Act.
